title: Review Clock Standards for Referrals and Authorizations
content:
The clocks that govern the review of **Referrals and Authorizations** requests are set per authorization type. Business days are counted Monday through Friday, federal holidays excluded; the other day counts are calendar days. A figure of 0 means the clock does not apply to that type.

## Standards

| Authorization type | Standard request decided within (business days after receipt) | Urgent request decided within (hours after receipt) | Pend period for missing clinical information (calendar days) | Decision letter issued within (business days after the decision) | Facility notice of an emergency admission (hours after admission) | Retrospective request accepted within (calendar days after the service start) | Concurrent review interval (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Specialty Care Referral | 2 | 72 | 14 | 2 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Rehabilitative Therapy Referral | 2 | 72 | 14 | 2 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | 5 | 72 | 14 | 2 | 0 | 30 | 0 |
| Home Health Care Authorization | 3 | 72 | 10 | 2 | 0 | 7 | 60 |
| Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization | 5 | 72 | 14 | 2 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization | 2 | 24 | 5 | 2 | 0 | 3 | 14 |
| Inpatient Mental Health Authorization | 1 | 24 | 3 | 2 | 24 | 3 | 3 |

## Reading the standards

- The decision letter goes to the patient and the providers within 2 business days of the decision for every type.
- A retrospective request figure of 0 means the type accepts no retrospective requests (Specialty Care Referral, Rehabilitative Therapy Referral, Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization).
- Only the Inpatient Mental Health Authorization has an emergency-admission notice figure (24 hours).
- The concurrent review interval is the number of calendar days between concurrent reviews of an ongoing stay or course: 60 days for home health, 14 days for skilled nursing facility stays, 3 days for inpatient mental health stays, and none for the other types.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A standard Home Health Care Authorization request received on a Monday with no federal holiday that week is due for decision by the Thursday, 3 business days later.
- A standard Specialty Care Referral request received on a Thursday with no federal holiday in the period is due by the following Monday, 2 business days later.
